name: Kiran Debnath
feedback: The session was informative, engaging, and well-organized. I really enjoyed the practical approach and the way the topics were explained. The activities made the session more interactive and helped me understand the concepts better. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely recommend the Student Builder Group (SBG) to others.
liked: The activities were interactive, engaging, and informative. I especially liked the practical approach, the teamwork, and the opportunities to learn and participate actively.
improvements: Improve the network connectivity during the event and provide more opportunities for participants to interact and connect with each other.

name: Misba Khatoon
feedback: It was awesome and really worth attending.
